title: Compositionality in large pre-trained models
reading: The slide asks whether large pre-trained generative models compose concepts correctly. It shows DALL-E 2 outputs for three prompts — 'A cup of coffee', 'A cat', and 'A cup of cat' — the last being a novel composition of familiar concepts. Credit is given to A. Torralba.

visuals.description: Three columns of DALL-E 2 generated images, labelled by the prompts 'A cup of coffee', 'A cat', and 'A cup of cat'.
visuals.assertion: A model that renders familiar concepts well can also combine them into novel, unseen compositions such as 'a cup of cat'.

concepts.name: Compositionality
concepts.why_it_matters: Ability to combine known concepts into novel meanings is a test of generalization.

concepts.name: DALL-E 2
concepts.why_it_matters: Large pre-trained text-to-image model used here as evidence of compositional generation.
